description.value: Laleh Bakery is a Persian pastry shop on North Vancouver's Lonsdale Avenue with over 30 years of experience producing traditional sweets such as baklava, saffron-infused cookies, and crispy zaban puff pastry. The bakery also hand-crafts fresh daily roulades and custom celebration cakes, making it a distinctive and aromatic stop on a North Shore cycling route. Indoor seating is available and both credit and debit cards are accepted.
